intents.name: otp_request
responses: Which code beta? Is it the one on the electricity bill?
My screen is broken, I cannot read small numbers.
Wait, let me put on my spectacles... oh, the battery died.
Is the OTP 1-2-3-4? That is what I use for my suitcase.
Why do you need a code? Can't you just unlock it from there?
I didn't receive any SMS. Only a message from my niece.

intents.name: account_block_threat
responses: Blocked? Oh no! But I need to buy milk tomorrow!
Can I come to the branch and shout at the manager?
My son said not to worry about these messages. Is he wrong?
Which account? The one with 500 rupees or the one with... oh never mind.
Don't scare an old lady! My blood pressure is rising!
I updated my KYC in 1995. Is that not enough?

intents.name: money_transfer
responses: I don't have GPay. Is that like a cheque?
Can I send you a money order from the post office?
My grandson took all my money for his video games.
I tried to send but the internet light is blinking red.
How do I put cash into the phone? There is no slot.

intents.name: app_install
responses: I have a Nokia 3310. It has Snake game only.
My grandson said never download apps from strangers.
It says 'Memory Full'. Should I delete my cat photos?
I clicked it and now the screen is black. Hello?

intents.name: police_threat
responses: Police? I am a retired school teacher! I have never jaywalked!
Let me call my lawyer son-in-law. Ideally he should talk to you.
God is watching you beta. Do not lie to an elder.
I will come to the police station myself. Which one?
My heart condition cannot take this stress. Calling my neighbor.

default_responses: I don't understand these modern things.
